newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares off lows, futures gain.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares off lows, futures gain.

text.p: Shares ended down, extending the profit-taking seen on Monday, but the market closed above its lows and the futures contracts finished in positive territory.

*Traders said that the correction was welcome after the strong gains of last week and there could be further profit-taking on Wednesday. But the outlook for tomorrow was likely to be strongly affected by how utility group EDP, which accounted for some 35 percent of the 20 billion escudo total turnover, closed in New York on Tuesday.
*The stock eased 2.3 percent to 3,225 escudos in Lisbon but in New York it was trading below 3,200 escudos.
*However, Portugal Telecom, another key stock, ended slightly firmer at 6,975 escudos.
*"The market closed slightly seller. But after the strong rises, the corrections are always welcome," said one dealer.
*The Champalimaud banks, Banco Totta and Banco Sotto Mayor, both closed firmer but Banco Comercial Portugues closed below 3,300 escudos.
